foundations.name: Retry/rate/backpressure
foundations.interface: Scoped account permit+known provider replay disposition -> one admissible physical attempt; separate client-to-API recovery policy
invariants: One provider/run retry authority owns physical attempts, account quota, provider Retry-After and durable workflow timing; unknown effect or commit remains charged. Separately, F01 permits at most three client-to-API sends within 30 seconds using the same key and deterministic 250ms/1s delays, applying a server Retry-After only when it fits the remaining client deadline. The client budget never truncates or otherwise governs provider/run retry scheduling.

invariants: 202 only after atomic idempotency/run/outbox/pending-reservation commit; exact replay creates no second reservation or dispatch.
